niche.habitat: 0.5-3 km altitude, under ice canopy, in thermal plumes
niche.diet: Filter-feeds airborne microbes, dissolves radiolytic peroxides

body: Buoyant gas bladder, thin membranous wings, streamlined neck

chains.trait: Bladder filled with H2 and CH4
links: Low molecular weight gas provides lift
Primordial H2 envelope exceeds escape velocity

skill.effect: Reduces fall damage to zero, enables passive altitude maintenance

chains.weakness: Vulnerable to puncture wounds releasing lift gas

plausibility.summary: Make float primarily dynamic/soaring (see Thermal Soar) with optional metabolically warmed bladder (lower ρ) or trace lighter volatiles in fissure gas (highly speculative). Game: passive altitude hold = riding updrafts; bladder = emergency lift after deliberate H2 vent, not perpetual lighter-than-local-H2.

chains.weakness: Helpless in calm, stagnant air pockets

journal.en: They dance on heat they cannot touch.

moments: A thermal column catches it, and the creature hangs motionless in the dark, a pale teardrop suspended in a sea of 12-bar silence.

journal.en: Wind is not a force here; it is a river.
